name: TC-869: @scenario S7 Sub + a drink, one drink out of stock — the storefront won't let the customer pick it; the others work
description: Build: Combo price → Sub + Cola with '+ Add an option' adding Lemonade and Iced Tea, $9.99, Save and turn on. Read back: the two lines with exactly the three drinks. Then Lemonade goes out of stock on the menu (PATCH availability, as the owner's menu toggle does). Edit: price → $10.49 (the deal still saves; the stored line keeps all three). The public v2 deal list then offers only Cola and Iced Tea, and lima + wind show only those two (both pickable, no Lemonade card). Sub + Iced Tea → deal $10.49, no upgrades, You're saving = $11.50 − $10.49.
